name: Tickglint: Smart Clock
tagline: ESP32 Smart Clock • 13 Clock Faces • Open Source
description: Tickglint is the companion app for the open-source Tickglint DIY smart clock: an ESP32 clock with a 12864 (ST7920) graphic LCD that you build yourself. The app sets the clock up over Bluetooth with a PIN shown on the clock's own screen, then controls everything from your phone: a live copy of the LCD with remote buttons, 8 alarms that ring on the clock even without Wi-Fi, timer, stopwatch and pomodoro, world clocks, sunrise, sunset and moon phase, birthdays and festivals with animated pop-ups, and scrolling messages sent from the phone. Pick from 13 clock faces in a picture gallery, with 12 animation effects, a screensaver and an animated clock background. Firmware updates over Bluetooth, or install it on a new ESP32-S3, ESP32 or ESP32-C3 board from the phone over USB-OTG. There is also a built-in setup guide with wiring diagrams, a troubleshooting guide and a demo mode that works without any hardware. No account, no ads, no tracking.
features: Bluetooth setup in a minute: pair with the PIN shown on the clock's LCD, set the time zone, time (no Wi-Fi needed), Wi-Fi and city
Live copy of the clock's LCD with remote buttons
13 clock faces chosen from pictures: digital, analog, flip, dot matrix, nixie, retro LCD, terminal, Pac-Man and more
8 alarms with repeat days and snooze, stored on the clock so they ring without Wi-Fi or the phone
Timer, stopwatch, pomodoro, hourly chime and 4 world clocks
Sunrise, sunset and moon phase calculated on the clock
Birthdays and Indian festivals with animated pop-ups and a countdown
Send a scrolling message to the clock's screen
12 animation effects, screensaver and an animated clock background
Firmware update over Bluetooth, or install from the phone over USB-OTG (ESP32-S3, ESP32, ESP32-C3)
Wiring diagrams with zoom, parts list and a troubleshooting guide inside the app
Demo mode: try every screen without any hardware
No account, no ads, no tracking
